stories.title: Tool Input Schema Definitions with Pydantic Models
stories.description: Define and enforce strict Pydantic schemas for all allowed tools, ensuring inputs are validated before execution and aligned with tool_models modules.

stories.title: Allowlist-Based Tool Dispatch Core Logic
stories.description: Implement the core routing logic that restricts tool execution to an explicit allowlist, validates inputs via Pydantic, and safely dispatches to domain services.

stories.title: Tool Router API Exposure and Error Handling
stories.description: Expose tool routing behavior through the FastAPI layer, including structured error handling for invalid tools, schema failures, and blocked (non-allowlisted) tool calls.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Tool Router
stories.description: Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests to validate allowlist enforcement, schema validation failures, successful dispatch, and interaction with the agent tool-use loop.
